segments.ch02.s0020: Now I am opening out like the largest telescope that ever was!
segments.ch02.s0040: Her head struck against the roof of the hall.
segments.ch02.s0050: She was now more than nine feet high.
segments.ch02.s0060: It was hopeless, so she sat down and began to cry again.
segments.ch02.s0070: You ought to be ashamed of yourself, a great girl like you!
segments.ch02.s0080: Stop this moment, I tell you!
segments.ch02.s0090: But she went on all the same, shedding gallons of tears.
segments.ch02.s0100: Soon there was a large pool all round her, four inches deep.
segments.ch02.s0110: The White Rabbit came trotting by, with white gloves and a large fan.
segments.ch02.s0130: He dropped the gloves and the fan, and hurried away.
segments.ch02.s0140: Alice picked up the fan and kept fanning herself.
segments.ch02.s0160: She dropped the fan just in time to save herself.
segments.ch02.s0180: She was up to her chin in salt water.
segments.ch02.s0190: It was the pool of tears she had wept when she was nine feet high.
segments.ch02.s0200: I wish I had not cried so much!
segments.ch02.s0210: I shall be punished for it now, by being drowned in my own tears!
segments.ch02.s0220: Something was splashing about in the pool a little way off.
segments.ch02.s0230: It was only a mouse that had slipped in like herself.
segments.ch02.s0240: O Mouse, do you know the way out of this pool?
segments.ch02.s0250: I am very tired of swimming about here, O Mouse!
segments.ch02.s0260: The Mouse looked at her, and seemed to wink, but it said nothing.
segments.ch02.s0270: Perhaps it does not understand English.
segments.ch02.s0290: The Mouse gave a sudden leap out of the water.
segments.ch02.s0310: I quite forgot you did not like cats.
segments.ch02.s0330: Would you like cats if you were me?
segments.ch02.s0340: I wish I could show you our cat Dinah.
segments.ch02.s0350: The Mouse was bristling all over.
segments.ch02.s0370: Do not let me hear the name again!
segments.ch02.s0390: The Mouse swam away from her as hard as it could go.
segments.ch02.s0400: Mouse dear, do come back again!
segments.ch02.s0410: We will not talk about cats or dogs, if you do not like them!
segments.ch02.s0420: The Mouse turned round and swam slowly back.
segments.ch02.s0430: Let us get to the shore, and I will tell you my history.
segments.ch02.s0440: The pool was getting quite crowded with birds and animals.
segments.ch02.s0450: There were a Duck and a Dodo, a Lory and an Eaglet.
segments.ch02.s0460: Alice led the way, and the whole party swam to the shore.
